Name: Sun Haven Animated Demon Tail (FS - Customizable Colors)
Author: FrutigerAero101
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
Add a brand new Accessory to your game.

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
1. Download and install *Fashion Sense*
2. Download this mod and extract the RAR file.
3. Copy the extracted folder and paste it into the *Local Pack - Accessories* folder inside your Fashion Sense.

[b]Requirements[/b]
Fashion Sense
